card.name: Verbs of affecting or changing levels
card.fires_on: Words meaning to affect or change something, such as 'Affect', 'influence', 'changes', or 'by', in drug-interaction and dose-adjustment text. It sits right before the thing being changed, such as a drug concentration or a dose.
